description: Get statistics on JavaScript library detection across the archive for a date range: total fingerprints, detection rate and the most common libraries, each with its most common versions. limit (default 100) caps the libraries and versions_limit (default 10) the versions listed per library; total_libraries and each library's version_count give the full numbers.

from_date.description: Start of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-01); omit for the API's default.
from_date.title: From Date

min_count.description: Leave out libraries seen fewer times than this.
min_count.title: Min Count

to_date.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601 (for example 2026-11-12); omit for the API's default.
to_date.title: To Date

versions_limit.description: Maximum number of versions listed per library, 0 to 1000 (default 10).
versions_limit.title: Versions Limit

name: get_jsfingerprint_library_stats
title: Get JS Fingerprint Library Stats
